claim: Legacy 2017 state geometry survives removal of generic cell responsiveness

claim: A shared outcome-to-late response structure is replicated across all five current VTA animals
evidence: Animal-level outcome-late r=0.633/0.769/0.404/0.649/0.740 for 54/181/112/113/185; 5/5 positive; mean r=0.655, animal bootstrap 95% CI 0.534-0.740, hierarchical cell-identity permutation p=2e-5. Raw delayed coupling remains 5/5 positive at 8-10 s (mean r=0.664, 95% CI 0.503-0.761).

claim: Raw outcome-to-late persistence cannot be interpreted as a kinetics-independent sustained neural state
evidence: AR(1) positive-innovation analysis in the four high-trial MAIN conditioning sessions weakens sharply as assumed calcium decay slows: for tau>=1 s, aggregate cell-shuffle p is 0.11-0.44 across delayed windows and split CIs include zero. Trial-level carryover residualization also removes the relation in several sessions, including ANM185. Therefore the five-mouse result is a response-structure claim, not proof of an autonomous sustained latent state.

claim: Delayed raw outcome-late coupling is strongest early and becomes animal dependent at longer lags
evidence: Five-animal delayed-window meta-analysis: 8-10 s mean r=0.664, 5/5 positive, 95% CI 0.503-0.761; 10-12 s mean r=0.421, 4/5 positive; 12-14.5 s mean r=0.384, 4/5 positive. ANM185 loses delayed coupling after 10 s.
